<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="ACME AG" processRef="INVOICE_PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="INVOICE_PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="SECRETARIAT" name="Secretariat">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>START_INVOICE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_RECEIVE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_INSPECT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_FORWARD</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="ACCOUNTING" name="Accounting employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_CREATE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_CHECK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_SEND</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>M_RETURN</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>G_ALL_AP</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_FORWARD_COMMERCIAL</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_CLARIFY</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>G_CONSULT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_CONSULT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>M_RESOLVED</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>M_SIGNATURE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_RESOLVE_COMPLAINT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_PAYMENT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_CLOSE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>END_INVOICE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="COST_CENTER" name="Cost center manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>M_REVIEW</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_REVIEW</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>G_ACCURATE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_MARK_AP</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_REJECT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>G_MORE_MANAGERS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_PASS_ON</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="COMMERCIAL" name="Commercial manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>M_AUDIT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_AUDIT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>G_COMPLAINT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_APPROVE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>G_AMOUNT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="BOARD" name="Board">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_BOARD_CHECK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="START_INVOICE" name="Invoice on paper or fax arrives" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_RECEIVE" name="Receive invoice in central inbox" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_INSPECT" name="Inspect invoice visually" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_FORWARD" name="Forward invoice to accounting employee" />

    <bpmn:task id="T_CREATE" name="Create invoice instance in ACME Financial Accounting" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_CHECK" name="Check invoice items and note cost centers and managers on docket" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_SEND" name="Send docket and copy of invoice to cost center manager" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="M_RETURN" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_ALL_AP" name="All positions marked AP?" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_FORWARD_COMMERCIAL" name="Forward copy of invoice to commercial manager" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_CLARIFY" name="Clarify inconsistencies with vendor" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_CONSULT" name="Consultation needed?" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_CONSULT" name="Consult cost center managers by telephone or e-mail" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="M_RESOLVED" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="M_SIGNATURE" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_RESOLVE_COMPLAINT" name="Resolve complaint with supplier" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_PAYMENT" name="Give payment instructions" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_CLOSE" name="Close instance in ACME Financial Accounting" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="END_INVOICE" name="Invoice closed" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="M_REVIEW" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_REVIEW" name="Review position for accuracy" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_ACCURATE" name="Position accurate?" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_MARK_AP" name="Mark position as accurate (AP) on docket" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_REJECT" name="Reject position with note and explanation on docket" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_MORE_MANAGERS" name="Further cost center manager on docket?" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_PASS_ON" name="Pass copy of invoice to next cost center manager" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="M_AUDIT" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_AUDIT" name="Perform commercial audit" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_COMPLAINT" name="Complaint during audit?" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_APPROVE" name="Issue approval for payment" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_AMOUNT" name="Amount exceeds EUR 20?" />

    <bpmn:task id="T_BOARD_CHECK" name="Check invoice again (four-eyes principle)" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F01" sourceRef="START_INVOICE" targetRef="T_RECEIVE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F02" sourceRef="T_RECEIVE" targetRef="T_INSPECT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F03" sourceRef="T_INSPECT" targetRef="T_FORWARD" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F04" sourceRef="T_FORWARD" targetRef="T_CREATE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F05" sourceRef="T_CREATE" targetRef="T_CHECK" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F06" sourceRef="T_CHECK" targetRef="T_SEND" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F07" sourceRef="T_SEND" targetRef="M_REVIEW" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F08" sourceRef="M_REVIEW" targetRef="T_REVIEW" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F09" sourceRef="T_REVIEW" targetRef="G_ACCURATE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" name="Yes" sourceRef="G_ACCURATE" targetRef="T_MARK_AP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" name="No" sourceRef="G_ACCURATE" targetRef="T_REJECT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F12" sourceRef="T_MARK_AP" targetRef="G_MORE_MANAGERS" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F13" name="Yes" sourceRef="G_MORE_MANAGERS" targetRef="T_PASS_ON" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F14" name="No" sourceRef="G_MORE_MANAGERS" targetRef="M_RETURN" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F15" sourceRef="T_PASS_ON" targetRef="M_REVIEW" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F16" sourceRef="T_REJECT" targetRef="M_RETURN" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F17" sourceRef="M_RETURN" targetRef="G_ALL_AP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F18" name="Yes" sourceRef="G_ALL_AP" targetRef="T_FORWARD_COMMERCIAL" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F19" name="No" sourceRef="G_ALL_AP" targetRef="T_CLARIFY" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F20" sourceRef="T_CLARIFY" targetRef="G_CONSULT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F21" name="Yes" sourceRef="G_CONSULT" targetRef="T_CONSULT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F22" name="No" sourceRef="G_CONSULT" targetRef="M_RESOLVED" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F23" sourceRef="T_CONSULT" targetRef="M_RESOLVED" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F24" sourceRef="M_RESOLVED" targetRef="T_SEND" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F25" sourceRef="T_FORWARD_COMMERCIAL" targetRef="M_AUDIT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F26" sourceRef="M_AUDIT" targetRef="T_AUDIT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F27" sourceRef="T_AUDIT" targetRef="G_COMPLAINT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F28" name="Yes" sourceRef="G_COMPLAINT" targetRef="T_RESOLVE_COMPLAINT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F29" name="No" sourceRef="G_COMPLAINT" targetRef="T_APPROVE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F30" sourceRef="T_RESOLVE_COMPLAINT" targetRef="M_AUDIT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F31" sourceRef="T_APPROVE" targetRef="G_AMOUNT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F32" name="Yes" sourceRef="G_AMOUNT" targetRef="T_BOARD_CHECK" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F33" name="No" sourceRef="G_AMOUNT" targetRef="M_SIGNATURE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F34" sourceRef="T_BOARD_CHECK" targetRef="M_SIGNATURE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F35" sourceRef="M_SIGNATURE" targetRef="T_PAYMENT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F36" sourceRef="T_PAYMENT" targetRef="T_CLOSE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F37" sourceRef="T_CLOSE" targetRef="END_INVOICE" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
